# Evidence — the receipts

Fleek's brief: *"Show the tools, the actual prompts **including the failures**."*

These pages hold 19 curated exchanges, quoted verbatim from the 10 real Claude Code sessions run between 2026-07-09 and 2026-07-10 while this engine was built. Nothing is reconstructed after the fact; every quote carries the timestamp it was typed at.

They are generated, not written. `scripts/extract_receipts.py` reads the raw transcripts against `manifest.json` and redacts every credential on the way out. The raw transcripts stay outside this repo — it is public, and they are not scrubbed.
